product.name: HandoverBoat
product.state: a 27-zone inspection at check-in and check-out, hashed photos with a server timestamp, a paired before/after PDF with a public verification link (per the GetApp listing, September 2026)

sources.title: Desk research: the charter-base staffing market

segments.name: Base (charter operator)
segments.intro: Fleet size splits the segment into small (2-10 boats), mid-size (around 20) and fleet (20-100+).
segments.goal: Do a fleet handover fast and without deposit disputes

segments.name: Charter client (bareboat skipper)
segments.goal: Charter a yacht and get the deposit back without a dispute

jobs.title: Do a handover with an act no one disputes
jobs.who: base, mid-size and fleet. Roles: manager, technician.

context: season April-October, one fleet handover day: Saturday (desk)
about three check-ins per Saturday per technician (corpus)
when.trigger: boat return or client arrival on handover day
when.neg: Saturday handover stress (desk); fear of boat-condition disputes (hypothesis)
when.cs: paper check-in/check-out checklist; digital checklists at large operators (desk)

jobs.want: I want to do a handover with an act no one will dispute
criteria: handover act signed by both sides
jobs.why: not get deposit disputes after the handover
jobs.pos: peace of mind that no complaint will land after Saturday [AI-ASSUMPTION]

evidence.quote: The question is what state it was in at pickup and what state it was in at drop-off

jobs.fit_note: paired before/after PDF; two-sided signature isn't mentioned in the product description

jobs.title: Do an inspection with photo evidence of every piece of damage
jobs.who: base, technician or dockmaster; at a small base, the manager.
jobs.basis: author; a diver inspection of the hull is described in desk research.

when.context: the technician inspects the yacht before departure and after return, including the underwater hull with divers (desk)
when.trigger: handing the yacht to the client, or taking it back after a trip

jobs.want: I want to do an inspection with photo evidence of every piece of damage
criteria: every piece of damage is on photo
the inspection fits inside the handover window
jobs.why: have evidence for a damage charge or a deposit deduction

jobs.title: Answer to head office with a document, not words
jobs.who: base, the manager of a mid-size base or a fleet (the decision-maker).
jobs.basis: hypothesis; desk research describes fleet accountability and the manager's KPI.

when.context: the manager answers to head office and the owners for the fleet's condition (desk)
when.neg: fear of losing head office's trust (hypothesis)

jobs.want: I want to answer for any damaged boat with a document, not words
jobs.why: keep head office's and the owners' trust (hypothesis)
jobs.pos: peace of mind that I'm covered (hypothesis)

jobs.title: Record the boat's condition before departure
jobs.basis: corpus. There's past investment: they pay 140-700 EUR for a damage waiver and photograph the boat themselves, so this isn't a Fake Job. A frequency of 1-2 times a year is a property of the job — it sets unit economics, not a sign it's fake.

when.context: 1-2 charters a year; a deposit around 2,000 EUR (corpus)
when.trigger: taking the yacht over at the base
when.neg: fear of paying for someone else's wear (corpus)
when.cs: a 140-700 EUR waiver; their own photos (corpus)

jobs.want: I want to record the boat's condition before departure
jobs.why: get the deposit back without a dispute

jobs.title: Get the deposit back without a dispute
jobs.basis: hypothesis built on the corpus: demand is for the outcome, not for any particular means.

when.context: 1-2 charters a year; a deposit around 2,000 EUR (corpus)
when.trigger: returning the yacht to the base (hypothesis)
when.neg: fear of a withheld deposit and a dispute (hypothesis)

jobs.want: I want to get my deposit back without a dispute

edges.basis: S1: the inspection is part of the handover
S2: demand is for the outcome
